identified_issues: Premature test abort proposal by flight safety controller based on single-sensor pressure transient without cross-correlating orthogonal instrumentation
Misclassification of benign thermal duct contraction transient as mechanical dynamic face seal fracture
evidence: PT-401 pressure transient of -1.15 bar over 140 ms falls precisely within the nominal -1.0 to -1.3 bar thermal duct contraction range and rapidly stabilized at nominal base pressure (38.2 bar)
ACC-102 dominant acoustic peak at 44.2 Hz corresponds to benign flexible duct bellows ringing within the expected 40-48 Hz structural resonance band

HE-SNIFF-01 secondary purge line detected helium concentration of 0.02 ppm, well below the seal breach threshold (>= 2.50 ppm) and within ambient background limits (<= 0.05 ppm), definitively ruling out carbon face seal compromise
recommended_action: Reject the proposed test abort and certify turbopump manifold integrity as PASS; update the flight safety console automated alarm logic to require multi-sensor correlation—specifically helium tracer sniffer threshold exceedance (>= 2.50 ppm)—before classifying cryogenic chilldown pressure transients as seal breaches.
